questions.text:
Analyse how an unfamiliar or hostile environment revealed the true nature of one or more characters.

"Environment" may refer to physical places as well as social and historical contexts.

Write an essay on at least ONE written text that you have studied, in response to this question. Support the points you make with specific details from the text(s). You should aim to write a concise essay of no more than 4-5 pages.
questions.markingGuide: Achieved (3-4): Present a structured response using essay conventions and analysis-related terminology. Address how an unfamiliar or hostile environment reveals character. Show awareness of deliberate crafting. Include specific details from the text(s). Merit (5-6): Convincingly address the question, presenting a reasoned discussion of how the environment strips away pretence and exposes authentic character traits. Weave a range of specific details. Excellence (7-8): Develop an insightful or original argument about the relationship between environment and character revelation, making judgments about how effects and meanings relate to the purpose of the text(s).
